messages:
Samira Lee: Quick ask — for the webinar + benchmark launch next Wed we need a small deliverables bundle: 3 benchmark micro-diagrams (one each: latency vs cost, throughput scaling, quality tradeoffs), a webinar hero (static + 16:9 animated GIF), and a modular slide template that the SDRs can drop into demos. Keep things compact and brand-safe. Need files by EOD Tue so we can QA and localize.

Priya Patel: Got it. Can you confirm target audiences for each asset and any mandatory copy? also accessibility requirements (contrast / alt text)?

Samira Lee: Audiences: 1) Engineers (latency/cost diagram) 2) Product leads/PMs (throughput scaling) 3) Exec/sales (quality vs cost tradeoff). Copy: one-line headline + 2–3 bullets each. Mandatory: Redwood logo lockup, legal footer: "Redwood Inference — ©2026". Accessibility: WCAG AA contrast; include alt text in delivered JSON.

Eli Choi: For the benchmark diagrams can we use the smaller sparkline style from the folk-kit? want to emphasize unit cost delta at 2k tokens. I'll drop the numbers: latency 20–80ms, cost/unit $0.0003–$0.003, throughput 100–5k tps depending on Dedicated config.

Marcus Rivera: Localization note — we'll need the text in EN, DE, FR, and JP. Best to keep copy under 40 chars for headline to avoid overflow. Also request: separate text layers in Figma so localizers can toggle.

Priya Patel: Design constraints: sizes — hero PNG 2400x1350, GIF 1280x720, slide template 1024x576 (powerpoint safe). Diagrams: deliver SVG + PNG @2x. Include a single-file JSON with alt-text and copy for each locale.

Juno (design-bot): New design ticket created: RD-2026-4883. Linked Figma file: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/redwood-launch-benchkit (permissions: marketing + design). Template branch: /micro-diagrams.

Samira Lee: One more — brand compliance check: no use of gradients outside brand palette, iconography must use approved set (icons/redwood/*). Priya can you run a quick brand sweep before handoff?

Priya Patel: Will do. ETA for first drafts: Mon 11am PT. If design needs actual benchmark plots, Eli can export CSVs.

Eli Choi: I'll export CSVs and a small sample notebook gist with plotting code: `https://gist.github.com/ech0/benchmark-plots` — includes `bench_latency.csv`, `bench_cost.csv`, `throughput_samples.csv`.

Marcus Rivera: For translations I'll outsource to L10n partner once we have the JSON. Please include context notes for short headlines.

Samira Lee: Perfect. Can we add a tiny social-ready cut (square 1080x1080) for each diagram? that'll help the launch thread.

Priya Patel: Yep — will include 1080x1080 variants and an assets csv describing filenames + intended use.

Samira Lee: Thanks team :rocket: If anything slips, ping me @samira — will triangulate with comms and ops.

Juno (design-bot): Reminder: delivery checklist attached to ticket RD-2026-4883. Items: Figma source, SVG/PNG exports, GIF hero, slide & PPT template, assets CSV, locale JSON, brand sweep sign-off.

Eli Choi: sending CSVs now in #marketing-assets -> `bench-data-1765554321.zip`

Priya Patel: Noted. Will post draft previews in this thread and in #design-review when ready. :eyes:

Samira Lee: Awesome — appreciate the quick turn.
